title: Identification of distinct clinical phenotypes of cardiogenic shock using machine learning consensus clustering approach.
summary: Consensus clustering of 21,925 eICU cardiogenic-shock patients identified two clinical phenotypes; the less-severe cluster was associated with lower mortality and AKI. This is retrospective phenotyping/association, not causal treatment guidance.
ai_technology: Unsupervised consensus clustering identifies patient groups from clinical/lab features.
